stem: Sofia wants to add a quotation after sentence 25 to support the idea that she is trying to convey. Which of the following could best accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: “She was in front of me the whole race, so she deserved to finish in front of me no matter what it took,” Vogel later commented.

options.label: B
options.text: “I remember moving to her position,” Vogel recalled after the event. “[McMath] was doing the best she could to keep her body upright.”

options.label: C
options.text: “We are a little bit of a minority being distance runners,” Vogel shared sometime later. “I think we all have an instant connection.”

options.label: D
options.text: Vogel quietly commented at a later time, “At the time, all I was thinking was that she fell so I probably should pick her up.”
